'''Rum Sleg''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. He was present in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] around the time of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

The [[Bone/Legends|skull]]-like face set in his helmet was one of ornament only, and not Rum's true face, so he could have been a representative of any of the thousands of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species in the galaxy.<ref name="Ask Lobot">{{InsiderCite|89|Ask Lobot|Ask the Master}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Rum Sleg's costume was present in the crowd of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. It stands to reason this was Rum. Rum Sleg was named for his Young Jedi CCG card after Dan Bojanowski's Star Wars RPG character.<ref name="Kallenbach">{{Twitter|chuckkallenbach|status/1315052864205537280|[[Chuck Kallenbach]]|quote=Absolutely. I was running the RPG on my kitchen table in Virginia Beach, and everybody named their own characters, of course. Dan's was named "Rum Sleg," and his battle cry was "Just Chill"! Is that all you need?}} {{C|In response to "Hi Chuck, could you confirm on here that Rum Sleg was named after Dan Bojanowski's Star Wars RPG character? We need something outside Wookieepedia to reference it to!"}}</ref>

[[File:Rumslegsurvivors.jpg|thumb|left|100px|An individual resembling Rum Sleg after death.]]
In the comic, "[[Survivors (comic story)|Survivors]]," an individual similar in appearance to Rum Sleg was killed by [[Uda-Khalid]], and was visible among the crowd of Uda-Khalid's victims.<ref name="Survivors comic">{{Tales|13|Survivors (comic story)}}</ref>

[[File:PodracingcrowdAA.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Rum in the crowd.]]
An action figure of Rum Sleg was made for [[Hasbro]]'s 2009 Legacy Collection. The figure featured a removable helmet, which did not reveal Sleg's face behind his faceplate but does show that he has whitish, lumpy, slimy skin and a brace of dreadlock-like appendages that are tied back in a ponytail. Whatever species Sleg may be, it is therefore confirmed that he is not human.

In the ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' comic [[Best Birthday Ever]], Rum Sleg is visible standing in line at the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] equivalent of a Post Office. The comic is non-canon, however.

Rum Sleg's [[Hasbro]] action figure a silver [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] identical in appearance to the [[DH-23 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-23 blaster pistol]].
